definitions.effective_pad_contact: exact pad/object identities, Fn > 0.2 N and signed_distance >= -0.001 m, matching frozen classifier
definitions.counting_unit: Per-returned-step contact-point records, not unique persistent spatial contacts or independent trials.
definitions.force_sign: Unfiltered native manifold: F_on_A=Fn*nOnB+Ft1*t1+Ft2*t2; on B is negative. All this dataset object contacts have object as A.
definitions.frame: W_T_link_post from COM/inertial transforms converted to URDF link frames; G=ip140_palm link frame, not its offset COM
definitions.point_timing_limit: Archived manifold witness locations may be cached before last integration; transformed using same returned state's W_T_link_post. Not recomputed closest-point geometry.
definitions.face: Nominal inward pad rectangle in URDF link frame x=[0,0.06],y=0,z=[-0.01,0.01]. Footprint and plane offset reported separately; rounded collision-margin contacts not relabelled exact face.
definitions.tip_depth: -x_G, positive behind G tip plane; object and pad witness depths both reported (not interchangeable)
definitions.force_and_impulse: Simulation reported forces and reconstructed signed impulses F*dt, not real hardware measurements; dt actual readback 1/240 s
definitions.balance: sum logged contact forces + mg - m*(v_k-v_(k-1))/dt. Includes unresolved damping/integration/solver terms; not a static-equilibrium claim.
definitions.damping_model: Optional btMultiBody formula -m*0.04*(1+||v_prev||)*v_prev from local source, commanded/audited value only; not an observed force.
definitions.post_touch_relative_motion: COM displacement in rotating G frame; not contact-point tangential slip measurement
